speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the third candle down to the socket since supper, and not a word written on the board.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: When I lie down, the gum hammers. When I walk, it only aches. So I walk.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: She will count the tallow in the morning and think the lovers have been busy. The lovers were not the reason. The tooth was.
